applications.title: Applications
applications.empty.heading: No applications yet
applications.empty.body: When a business applies for wholesale on your store, the application appears here for you to review.
applications.search.label: Search applications
applications.search.placeholder: Business name, email or tax number
applications.sort.label: Sort by
applications.selectAll: Select all applications on this page
applications.noResults.heading: No applications match
applications.noResults.body: Try a different search or clear the filters.
applications.bulk.approveExplain: Each business gets a company in Shopify and is added to the tier you pick. Applications that are missing an address are skipped and stay in Pending.
applications.bulk.noTiers: You need a tier before you can approve. A tier sets the prices these buyers see.
applications.bulk.approvedSummary: {count, plural, one {# application approved.} other {# applications approved.}}
applications.bulk.rejectedToast: {count, plural, one {# application rejected} other {# applications rejected}}
applications.detail.waitingForApplicant: Waiting for the applicant to reply
applications.detail.checkManually: The official registry couldn't be reached. Please check this number yourself before approving.
applications.detail.assigneeHelp: Type a staff member's name. Only your team sees this.
applications.detail.toast.needs_info: Request saved. Send the applicant the message with the secure link.
applications.needsInfo.heading: Ask for more information
applications.needsInfo.template.certific: Thanks for applying. Could you please upload your resale or tax exemption certificate so we can finish reviewing your application?
applications.needsInfo.template.taxNumbe: Thanks for applying. We couldn't confirm your tax number. Could you please check it and send it again?
applications.needsInfo.template.business: Thanks for applying. Could you tell us a bit more about your business, for example your website or where you sell?
applications.needsInfo.messageRequired: Write a message so the applicant knows what to send.
applications.needsInfo.fieldsHelp: The applicant gets a private link that is valid for 14 days and can only change these fields.
applications.reject.heading: Reject {company}?
applications.reject.template.notEligible: Thank you for your interest. At the moment we only offer wholesale to businesses that match our requirements, and we can't approve this application.
applications.reject.template.incomplete: Thank you for your interest. We couldn't verify the information in your application, so we can't approve it right now. You're welcome to apply again.
applications.reject.template.region: Thank you for your interest. We don't offer wholesale in your area yet.
applications.reject.reasonHelp: Saved with the application and included in the message you can send the applicant.
applications.reject.consequence: The application moves to Rejected. Nothing is created in Shopify, and you can still find it under the Rejected tab.
applications.detail.taxCheckPlan: Tax numbers are checked against official registries on the {plan} plan and up. Check this one manually, or upgrade to check new applications automatically.
applications.bulk.replyHelp: Each applicant gets this reply in their language when you've written it in that language.
applications.detail.accessEmailHint: The buyer signs in with their email and a one-time code. You can also send Shopify's own B2B access email from the contact on the company page in Shopify admin, or automatically with a Shopify Flow workflow (Help explains how).
applications.detail.approvedDefaults: Approved with the suggested tier, terms and tax settings.
applications.detail.error.approval_start: An approval already started for this application. Open it and choose Retry to finish, or Undo to remove what was created, before deciding again.
applications.detail.error.busy: Someone else is working on this application right now. Wait a moment and try again.
applications.detail.error.fields_require: Choose at least one question for the applicant to answer.
applications.detail.error.message_requir: Write a message so the applicant knows what to send.
applications.detail.error.not_open: This application was already decided, so nothing changed. Refresh the page to see its current status.
applications.detail.error.note_required: Write something before saving the note.
applications.keys.heading: Keyboard shortcuts
applications.native.catalogs: Volume pricing and quantity rules: open the tier's catalog in Shopify
applications.native.deposits: Deposits (Shopify Plus): set them on the company location's payment terms
applications.native.heading: Finish the setup in Shopify
applications.native.terms: Payment terms, more locations and contacts: open the company in Shopify
applications.print.footer: Printed from Tradepass on {date}. Tax numbers are shortened; documents are in your Shopify Files.
applications.risk.disposable_email: The email address is on a throwaway inbox service (like mailinator.com). Real businesses rarely use one.
applications.risk.free_email: The email address is on a free email service, not the company's own domain.
applications.risk.heading: Worth a second look (this never blocks anything)
applications.risk.po_box: The shipping address is a P.O. box.
applications.risk.registry_mismatch: The name in the tax registry doesn't match the company name.
applications.risk.website_mismatch: The website's domain doesn't match the email domain.
